Subject: Security & deployment scope — NovumHealth (post-call)

Hi Claire / Novum security team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and the items we agreed to move forward with so we can get the right materials into your compliance review: 

- Scope: Novum plans to evaluate Redwood Private (VPC-hosted) and an on-prem air-gapped option for PHI-handling workloads. Primary goal is to confirm network isolation and data residency before a POC.
- Compliance baseline: you said HIPAA applies, and you are interested in our SOC 2 Type II scope and GDPR controls for European patient data.
- Immediate asks we agreed on:
  1) Novum to share the most recent SOC 2 report or SOC 2 evidence summary (redacted is OK).
  2) Novum to confirm whether the planned PII/PHI flow will include egress of identifiable data to any hosted logs or third-party analytics.
  3) Redwood to provide a short vendor questionnaire (we will send v1) and an initial diagram template for the VPC and air-gap options to capture required network/DNS/firewall controls.
  4) Schedule a 30-minute follow-up with SecureOps (diagraming) to align on segmentation and tunnel/bastion requirements.

Action items I’m taking: I will attach the vendor_questionnaire_v1.docx and a diagram template to this thread for your security team to fill. Lauren will follow up with a short matrix of data-in-transit encryption and key management options for the Private deployment. Aditya will map the expected tokenization/pseudonymization steps for the POC.

Please reply in-thread with the SOC 2 evidence or an estimated delivery date. Also let us know if you want us to redact anything in the report before sharing.

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Diego —

Appreciate the clear recap. Short answers and what we attached:

- SOC 2: We have a SOC 2 Type II report for our platform (FY 2026). I attached a redacted copy (SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf) and a one-pager of relevant controls.
- HIPAA/GDPR: Confirmed — HIPAA applies to the PHI workflows; GDPR applies for our EU regions. We will need documentation on data residency, access control, and encryption-in-transit + at-rest.
- Data flow: Our current plan for the POC will not intentionally send full identifiers to third-party analytics. There are legacy logs that may contain truncated identifiers — we will provide the log retention policy.

Attachments in this email: SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (redacted), novum_network_roles.xlsx (roles mapping). We are happy to complete your vendor_questionnaire.

Diego

Diego / Claire —

Thanks for the invite. Attached is an initial isolation sketch (secureops_isolation_sketch.png) that outlines the two deployment patterns and the minimal controls I recommend for SOC 2/HIPAA alignment:

- VPC option: dedicated project, private subnets for inference nodes, strict SGs limiting egress to the customer-maintained logging endpoint (TLS 1.2+), managed bastion with MFA, and KMS-backed disk encryption. Use a transit gateway only if cross-region replication is required.
- Air-gapped option: physically isolated compute, jump-box for offline updates, USB-less media ingestion only via approved transfer station, and a write-only export path for aggregated metrics to a hardened appliance.

I can convert the sketch into a formal diagram in PowerPoint for Novum's architecture review. Proposed next step: a 30-minute session Wed 27 Apr 10:00 ET to walk the sketch and capture any additional constraints.

Tom Reyes
Principal Consultant, SecureOps
